about: How the 3D Vig bust moves (BRD-001). Canonical copy: norviq-web-v2/design/vig-motion.json; byte copy in norviq-ios financeplan/Design/. Drivers: src/lib/vig-motion.ts and Design/VigMotion.swift. Angles in degrees; rise in model heights (the model is 1.0 tall); times in seconds. Positive yaw turns the face toward +X (the viewer's right); positive pitch tips the face down. Expected values: vig-motion.fixtures.json, generated by scripts/brand/vig_motion_fixtures.py.
